title: Reference approach: First Classifier
answer: Implement first classifier in a small isolated script. Required implementation evidence includes: nn.Linear, CrossEntropyLoss, optimizer.step, model.eval. Use a reproducible seed, report observed output, and explain relevant edge cases.
explanation: This exercise consolidates the topic from lesson 060. The list of required strings is only a minimal static signal; inspect numerical correctness, error handling, and test outcomes manually.
example_code:
import torch
from torch import nn
torch.manual_seed(3); x=torch.randn(32, 2); y=(x[:, 0] + x[:, 1] > 0).long(); model=nn.Linear(2,2); opt=torch.optim.SGD(model.parameters(), lr=0.2)
for _ in range(30): opt.zero_grad(); loss=nn.CrossEntropyLoss()(model(x), y); loss.backward(); opt.step()
model.eval()
with torch.inference_mode(): print(((model(x).argmax(1)==y).float().mean().item()))
reference_code:
import torch
from torch import nn
torch.manual_seed(3); x=torch.randn(32, 2); y=(x[:, 0] + x[:, 1] > 0).long(); model=nn.Linear(2,2); opt=torch.optim.SGD(model.parameters(), lr=0.2)
for _ in range(30): opt.zero_grad(); loss=nn.CrossEntropyLoss()(model(x), y); loss.backward(); opt.step()
model.eval()
with torch.inference_mode(): print(((model(x).argmax(1)==y).float().mean().item()))
